text_block_list.text: Since Maruzensky hasn't shown up for training, I decide to take care of some other work, when...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's a bit hard for me to say, though...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Some boring stuff suddenly came up.
Tee-hee, my bad! Forgive me, pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll make up for being late today.
Deal?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'm sorry for making you worry.

Assuming there was a good reason for it,
I refrained from prying too deeply, but...

Later on, I learned that Maruzensky
had been listening to her junior's troubles.
